recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-17253; future corrections to DICOM endpoint-connection-type target URLs should stay in the separate THO/UTG track identified by FHIR-50770, FHIR-53728, and UP-775.
issue_request: FHIR-17253 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for R5 asking the Endpoint Scope and Usage DICOM/imaging bullet to change from query-only wording with QIDO-RS, WADO-RS, or WADO-URI to "Location of where to query, retrieve or store imaging content and metadata (QIDO-RS, WADO-RS, WADO-URI, STOW-RS)".
initial_application: The DICOM/imaging bullet was originally added for FHIR-14100 by git commit fe0b0b0dae752745d989a9b6c408341e7572cf16. FHIR-17253 was then explicitly applied by git commit d1732ddecc196dd7db2c0a5748a5aa2bcb6c7444, which replaced the older query-only text with the approved query/retrieve/store wording including STOW-RS.
additional_context: Endpoint is active in source/fhir.ini. Current Endpoint source binds Endpoint.connectionType to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/endpoint-connection-type and the Endpoint example template includes DICOM WADO-RS, QIDO-RS, STOW-RS, and WADO-URI rows. Later DICOM endpoint-connection-type issues FHIR-50770 and FHIR-53728 concern THO/UTG maintenance of DICOM code-system URLs rather than this core Endpoint Scope and Usage narrative.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/endpoint/endpoint-introduction.xml already contains the exact approved FHIR-17253 wording in an active build-scope Endpoint narrative file.
